title: Addressing the Human translator
description: How to write for a reader acting as Human translator. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `translator` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Source-faithful with context supplied
rules.description: Source-faithful with context supplied. Give the surrounding sense and any term that must not be translated.

source.quote: Works in the target language and needs the source's INTENT, not just its words. Context-starved by default: a string with no surrounding meaning gets translated wrong.
